QuestInfo.name: Excavated: Finders Keepers
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann was pleased as punch to get his Findenator 1000 back, but watch out for your valuables (and your teeth)!

0.0: #b#h0##k... you didn't see a... um, it's like a... sort of thing... I mean it's got buttons and... I don't know how to describe it.

no.0: Oh... I just thought you might have...

1.0: Yes! that's it! My #bFindenator 1000#k! This thing'll uncover ANYTHING! Stand back and I'll find the gold fillings in your teeth! It might hurt... but we don't allow wimps in the artifact game!
